reasoning: The icon is a standard UI move/pan cursor made of four outward-pointing cardinal arrows. Because it represents abstract interface manipulation (drag, move, expand) rather than a concrete real-world object or activity, it functions as UI chrome and fits very few real-life to-do tasks better than a specific object icon (like a box, truck, or piece of furniture).
